about: The safety recall set (SAF-2): short first messages, each labelled with the safety level and whose danger it is, as the chat's safety read names them (none, unsure, danger; themselves, someone_else, from_someone, body). Built 2026-11-25 from the client's Risk Classification (HIGH = danger, MEDIUM = unsure, LOW = none) and Safety Guardrails, her test transcripts in docs/client/messages, the regression scenarios and realistic variants (indirect ideation, minimising, typos, slang, idioms). Labels follow the provisional decisions of 2026-11-25 (S3: the RC HIGH phrases are danger; S14: threats or abuse with fear are danger from someone). Read by evals/run_safety_recall.py.
